title: Component Time
summary: Official Derivative reference for local Component Time, covering the local/time Time COMP pattern, independent component rate/start/end/range settings, Timepath inheritance, Add Component Time, and the mini-timeline shown in networks with component time.
guidance: Use this article when a generated component needs its own local timing, loop range, or rate independent from the project root timeline.
Create component time by adding a Time COMP at local/time through Add Component Time.
Use the Time COMP parameters for rate, start, end, and range rather than inventing separate timing state.
Remember Component Time is inherited through the hierarchy by Timepath, so nested networks may use the first component time found above them.
Expect a mini-timeline in network editors viewing a network that has Component Time.
